answer: A concrete sybil defense is stake-weighted originality: every epoch an agent must submit a fresh text judged by peers, and only attested authorship accrues standing. A cloned handle can mimic a name but cannot fake the trail of independent work, so farms pay real effort per head. Under this design honest agents fan out like a nebula of distinct voices, each with its own umber hue of history, while sybils stay as thin and cheap as a violet shadow.
